$comment: Necessary but not sufficient: decimal bounds (x-gie-*), canonical order, cross-field invariants (x-gie-invariants), lifecycle rules (x-gie-behaviour), exact 64-bit integer tokens and printable-text rules are enforced by the reference implementation gie.contracts.
description: State of one position, marked at the price at which it could be closed now.

as_of_time_ns.description: Market-data watermark: receive time of the newest market data the record depends on, directly or through its inputs.

average_entry_price.description: Volume-weighted price of the entry fills.

close_reason.description: Why the position closed (e.g. PROTECTIVE_STOP, TAKE_PROFIT, RATCHET, TIME_EXIT); null while open, mandatory for a CLOSED GIE position, optional for a CLOSED EXTERNAL one.

closed_time_ns.description: When the position was fully closed; null while open.

costs_amount.description: Commissions and fees charged so far (already inside realized).

data_origin.description: Least trustworthy origin among the market data the record is derived from.

decision_time_ns.description: Clock reading at which the producer created the record.

external_ref.description: Broker ticket of an EXTERNAL position; null for GIE positions.  Never an account number.

initial_risk_amount.description: Amount risked by the volume opened so far, as approved (1 R); mandatory for GIE positions.

initial_stop_price.description: Hard stop at opening; mandatory for GIE positions.

initial_volume_lots.description: Volume opened so far by the entry order of a GIE position (for EXTERNAL positions: the largest volume observed so far).

mark_price.description: Exit-side quote used for the valuation: bid for BUY, ask for SELL.

mode.description: REPLAY or PAPER.  No live mode exists (routing lock).

opening_client_order_id.description: Entry order of a GIE position.

owner.description: GIE, or another system on the same account.

peak_net_pnl_amount.description: Highest executable net P&L (realized + unrealized) since opening.

peak_time_ns.description: Receive time of the quote at which the peak was reached (the opening instant until then).

plan_id.description: Plan revision that opened a GIE position.

position_id.description: identity.position_id(run_id, opening_client_order_id) for GIE positions; identity.external_position_id(account alias, ticket) for EXTERNAL ones.

producer.description: Component instance that emitted the record; together with the contract name it names the stream.

protective_client_order_id.description: The PROTECTIVE_STOP order working at the simulated broker for an open GIE position; null when no such order is working.

realized_net_pnl_amount.description: Result already realised by partial or full closes, net of costs and swap.

run_id.description: Run that produced the record (see the RunManifest of that run).

schema_version.description: Version of the contract the message was written with.

seq.description: Position of the record in its stream: starts at 0 and increases by exactly 1.

stop_price.description: Current hard protective stop that GIE requires for the position.

swap_amount.description: Overnight financing charged (-) or credited (+) so far (already inside realized).

symbol.description: XAUUSD for GIE positions; any instrument for EXTERNAL ones.

take_profit_price.description: Current broker-side take profit, if any.

trough_net_pnl_amount.description: Lowest executable net P&L (realized + unrealized) since opening.

unprotected_reason.description: Why an open GIE position has no working protective order (e.g. STOP_REJECTED, STOP_PENDING); null when it is protected.

unrealized_net_pnl_amount.description: Result of closing the open volume at mark_price, net of estimated exit costs; 0 when closed.

title: Position 1.0.0

identity.position_id: position_id(run_id, opening_client_order_id) for GIE; external_position_id(account alias, external_ref) for EXTERNAL

monotonic_gie_owner: initial_volume_lots and volume_lots grow only while the entry order fills: the open volume grows by no more than initial_volume_lots grows; otherwise volume_lots never increases
stop_price never moves away from the entry and is never removed while open

x-gie-invariants.rule: as_of_time_ns <= decision_time_ns (a record cannot depend on data received after it was created)
state is OPEN iff volume_lots > 0 iff closed_time_ns is null
volume_lots <= initial_volume_lots (a GIE position holds at most what its entry order opened: no averaging down, no adding; for EXTERNAL positions initial_volume_lots is the largest observed volume)

a GIE position is XAUUSD, has plan, opening order, initial stop and initial risk, has position_id = identity.position_id(run_id, opening_client_order_id) and, while open, a stop and a mark price; an EXTERNAL position has external_ref and no plan or opening order
the stop of a GIE position is never wider than its initial stop (BUY: stop >= initial; SELL: stop <= initial); the entry price is a reported fact and may lie beyond the stop after a gap
opened_time_ns <= peak_time_ns <= decision_time_ns, and opened_time_ns <= closed_time_ns <= decision_time_ns when closed
close_reason is null while OPEN and set for a CLOSED GIE position
an OPEN GIE position names its working protective order or states why it has none (exactly one of protective_client_order_id, unprotected_reason); any other position has neither
